faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Starlite Marbella venue?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about 10 minutes by car from the Starlite auditorium at Cantera de Nagüeles. After your cruise, we can help you arrange a taxi or private transfer to the venue. Most guests book a 2-hour cruise, disembark, and take a short ride to the concert, arriving relaxed and on time.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a Starlite pre-concert cruise?
faq.a: For a Starlite cruise, we recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) at €749 for 2 hours. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is included in the pre-concert cruise price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden costs. You just bring your Starlite tickets and your party spirit.

faq.q: Can we set our own departure time to match our concert tickets?
faq.a: Yes. We tailor departure times to your Starlite schedule. Most guests choose a 2-hour cruise departing 3 hours before the concert starts. That gives you time to sail, enjoy drinks, disembark, and reach the venue with plenty of buffer. Just tell us your ticket time when booking.

faq.q: Is there parking at Puerto Banús for our car?
faq.a: Puerto Banús has several public car parks, including the underground parking at the marina and the large lot near the N-340. Rates are typically €2–€3 per hour. Alternatively, we can arrange a taxi to pick you up and drop you at the marina, avoiding parking hassle entirely.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on the day of our cruise?
faq.a: Your safety is our priority. If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we will reschedule your cruise to another time or date, or offer a full refund. Starlite runs from June to August, so weather is usually calm, but we always monitor forecasts.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or decorations on board?
faq.a: You're welcome to bring a birthday cake or small decorations. However, our standard package already includes light snacks and drinks. For special requests like champagne or custom catering, contact us via WhatsApp to arrange a bespoke package.

data.body_html:
Starlite Marbella is the summer's hottest ticket, but getting to the venue can be a traffic nightmare. Skip the jams and arrive in style with a pre-concert yacht cruise from Puerto Banús. Sail along the Costa del Sol, sip cava as the sun sets over La Concha, and step off the boat feeling fresh and ready for the show. With departures every day from Puerto Banús, our Starlite Marbella pre-concert cruise is the smartest way to start your evening.

Why take a pre-concert yacht cruise?

The Starlite auditorium sits in the Cantera de Nagüeles, a quarry-turned-open-air venue just north of Marbella. On concert nights, the roads around the Golden Mile grind to a halt. A yacht cruise avoids all that. You'll board in Puerto Banús, enjoy a relaxing sail along the coast, and disembark just a 10-minute taxi ride from the venue. No stress, no traffic, no parking fees — just a smooth, glamorous start to your night.

Our boats for Starlite evenings

We have a fleet of yachts and speedboats departing from Puerto Banús, all suitable for a pre-concert sail. For couples or small groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect. Both are available at our Tier A rate of €749 for 2 hours, which includes skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. For larger parties of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats like the Pershing 46 or Ferretti 94 are available on request — message us on WhatsApp for a quote.

What's included in your charter

Every Starlite pre-concert cruise includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You won't pay extra for anything — just show up with your tickets and your sunglasses. The skipper will handle navigation, anchorage, and even recommend the best photo spots along the coast.

Sample itinerary: 2-hour sunset sail

Here's a typical 2-hour pre-concert cruise from Puerto Banús:

  • 18:30 — Board your yacht at Puerto Banús, meet the skipper, and receive a safety briefing.
  • 18:45 — Depart the marina, heading east towards Marbella. Pass the famous Golden Mile and spot the luxury villas of the rich and famous.
  • 19:15 — Anchor in a quiet cove near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Swim in the warm Mediterranean (if you're brave) or just relax on deck with a glass of cava.
  • 20:00 — Cruise back towards Puerto Banús, enjoying the golden hour light on La Concha mountain.
  • 20:30 — Disembark, hop in a taxi (5–10 minutes), and arrive at Starlite in time for the opening act.

Prefer a longer sail? Extend to 3 or 4 hours to include a stop at Cabopino or even a sunset cruise along the coast to Estepona.

Our Starlite pre-concert cruise pricing is transparent:

To book, simply contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date and boat. We'll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. A 50% deposit secures your slot, with the balance due on the day. For last-minute bookings, we often have slots available — just ask.

Make it a full Starlite experience

Combine your pre-concert cruise with a post-concert return trip, or add a private chef and premium champagne for a truly VIP evening. We can also arrange a taxi to pick you up from the marina and take you to the venue — just let us know. And if you're celebrating a birthday or anniversary, tell us in advance and we'll surprise you with a small cake or a bottle of bubbly.
